mission: Deliver bounded six-form citation extraction and document-local linking on supplied plain text, with schema-first semantic values, exact verified source anchors, explicit ambiguity and Effect-native resource boundaries.
statusNote: Closed completed-retained through final #2966 (merged 2026-11-09T02:51Z, 9f44753a8c1, through a ruleset bypass). Its cancelled Heavy / Check, Heavy / Test Integration, Heavy / Docgen and Heavy / Doctest are attributed with their fix PRs (#2984, #2994) in decisions/2026-11-13-final-2966-attributed-reds.md. The goal-closeout-hosted-verification batch migration adopted the legacy proposal. Historical exhaustive obligations are superseded, not passed.

completionGate.statement: Achieved only when the approved six-form contract, selected real Layer, reviewed profile/source/link/resource evidence, owned CI repairs, attribution, reflection and lifecycle update are merged and verified retained on main through linked Yeet PRs.

phases.name: Source baseline and exhaustive capability accounting
Differential, span, transform, regex, and repo verification
Close one Yeet PR to mergeable
Approved six-form scope and evidence rebaseline
Bounded implementation and owned CI repairs
Hosted proof, reflection and verified retention

verificationCommands: bun run beep goals decisions check
stopConditions: Required public prerequisite contracts are absent or incompatible.
Exact verified source fidelity, explicit ambiguity or bounded responsive execution cannot be demonstrated.
A selected runtime conflicts with an unresolved repository constraint.
Verification requires unauthorized cost, credentials or broader product authority.
The six-form contract would be silently weakened or exhaustive parity reintroduced without a new operator ruling.
